# RAINGAIA

> RAINGAIA LLC builds Raingaia Network: deterministic network detection and response (NDR). The same traffic always produces the same verdict, detection rates are measured on public datasets before they are claimed, and every response action is cryptographically signed, bounded by rules on the customer's own machine, and audited. Florida, USA limited liability company, established 2025.

The "quantum-probabilistic" language in RAINGAIA's technical material refers to borrowing the mathematical formalism of quantum probability theory (state vectors, density operators, entropy) to reason under uncertainty -- no quantum computing or quantum hardware is involved; the software runs on standard CPUs.

## Product

- **Raingaia Network** (https://network.raingaia.com): Network detection and response for teams from a single office to 100+ devices. A lightweight sensor (raw packet capture stays on the host; derived signals are analyzed in a per-customer isolated engine), eleven named attack detectors (command-and-control beaconing, brute force, scans, lateral movement, exfiltration and more), signed response on hosts and managed switches, and SIEM integration (signed webhooks, Splunk HEC, syslog/CEF, pull API). Plans from $50/month. Full, current detail: https://network.raingaia.com/llms.txt

## Company

RAINGAIA LLC, 7901 4th St N Ste 300, St. Petersburg, FL 33702, United States. Contact: support@raingaia.com.
